name: StarBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a star coral structure. The object shows a rounded, squat dome shape densely covered in raised cylindrical ring elements — each ring representing an individual polyp cup with an open hollow center, arrayed tightly across the entire dome surface. Without any texture or material color, the pure white geometry clearly reveals the regular pattern of protruding rings and hollow openings, with a wavy perimeter at the base where the rings meet the ground plane.
